outcome.detail: All 18 checks matched. unavailable: stated, and Transcribe, Import Audio, and Record are closed; the caption fixture: 4 segments labeled as imported captions; a caption correction kept its time; an annotation was added and an overlapping one refused; the fallback saved with an app-UI receipt; transcription: 4 guesses shown, 2 segments, no guess left; the audio reference is the copy's SHA-256, not its name; a transcript correction kept its time; the caption export kept the times and the corrected text; the timeline export kept times, word times, and the recognized text; the transcript saved once; Save again returned the same receipt; this build's Record fell back with its reason and opened nothing; the route change paused the recording, kept its segment, and was announced; Resume continued the same timeline after the kept segment; the recording saved with an app-UI receipt; the collection holds 3 saved transcripts and the person's own item; the experiment's Reset and Reset Demo left all 4 items unchanged; the store holds the 4 items as the person's own, and each save's app-UI create-item receipt.
